description: MOAA catalog: on a strong match, name up to 3 disabled-plugin skills that fit the prompt

hooks.command: for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 && $p -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))' 2>/dev/null && exec $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/catalog.py" hook prompt; done; exit 0
